purpose: Second playable arcade cabinet: Frogger-inspired road and river crossing with five homes and three escalating rounds.
runtimeSurface: Existing Three.js/Vite arcade; desktop elevated follow camera with optional frog-eye view; WebXR frog-eye camera.

hero.role: Playable frog with an unobscured landing area and readable next lane

exceptions: Moving traffic and floating platforms deliberately have asymmetric phases and directions.
Organic bank vegetation varies within symmetric placement envelopes.
Arcade cabinet occupies the right VECTOR bay; Brickstorm remains in the central bay.

circulation.description: Direct cabinet entry onto a 3.4 m wide safe bank. Thirteen discrete rows: start, five traffic lanes, safe median, five river lanes, five home pads. Continuous side berms contain play.

functionalExceptions: Outdoor gameplay area: terrain substrate has thickness, but no roof or enclosing walls are proposed. Side berms provide explicit collision containment.
Arrival is a cabinet portal to a visible open bank, not a decorative architectural doorway.
Use Blender-authored geometry and built-in generated references; do not submit to a paid image-to-3D provider. This exception is pending user review.
